messages:
Marta: heads-up — seeing a perf regression in prefix/prompt cache after the recent kernel-selection canary. Sampled 10k requests on canary: hit-rate down from ~62% -> ~47%. GPU mem usage spiked and OOM throttles increased.
Devon: ugh. any quick diffs? did key canonicalization change, or batching heuristics?
Marta: here's the snapshot we pulled: ```cache_hits: 4700
cache_misses: 5300
hit_rate: 0.47
avg_latency_ms: 42 -> 58
gpu_free_mb: 1200 -> 600
oom_events: 5
```
Aj: that looks like fragmentation + more unique keys. Did the KV keying start including session ids / ephemeral tokens after the kernel change?
Marta: I audited a few anonymized keys, saw a pattern — some keys have trailing spaces and small suffixes. Also TTL is uniformly 30m across all prefixes right now.
Leo: I'll spin a profiler on the canary to dump top-k key distribution and slot utilization.
Sam: thinking out loud: we should split the cache into cohorts. Hot cohort: normalized prefix hash -> longer TTL + softcap on evict. Warm cohort: CPU-backed LRU with short TTL to absorb churn. That will reduce GPU slab fragmentation and OOM risk.
Devon: Agreed. Also consider probabilistic LRU (pLRU) + periodic compaction when fragmentation > 30%. That can merge underutilized slots and reduce OOM pressure.
Aj: concrete experiments to run: 1) Fix canonicalization (trim + normalize) + unit tests for hashing; 2) Cohorting + TTL tweak (hot TTL=60m, warm TTL=5m) with routing to CPU for warm; 3) Compact-slab sweep job every 5m when frag > 30%; 4) Re-run kernel batch-size param as a control (batch 8 vs 12).
InfraBot: Deployment queued: canary-2026-03-18-2 -> running smoke tests.
Marta: I'll own experiments 1 & 2 on canary. Will push normalization patch and add an endpoint test that asserts stable key for canonical inputs.
Devon: Aj/Devon will pair on implementing compaction and the frag-metrics. I'll add metrics: `cache_frag_ratio`, `avg_slot_util`, `evict_softcap_cnt`.
Leo: quick note: the kernel selection change also nudged the batching heuristic for short sequences (8 -> 12) which could change prefix shapes and reduce reuse. Add `batch_size_dist` to captured profile so we can correlate.
Aj: measurement plan: collect 100k requests per experiment, record hit_rate, avg_latency, gpu_free_mb, oom_events, cache_frag_ratio. Baseline now: hit_rate=0.47, oom_events=5. Target: hit_rate >= 0.58 and oom_events <= 1.
Marta: checklist: 
- [ ] fix key canonicalization + unit tests
- [ ] add normalized hashing regression test in CI
- [ ] implement cohort routing (gpu-hot / cpu-warm)
- [ ] add compaction sweep job + threshold config
- [ ] capture 24h canary run for each change (100k reqs)
- [ ] add dashboards for `cache_frag_ratio`, `avg_slot_util`, `batch_size_dist`
- [ ] sync Friday 11:00am to review results
Sam: I'll prototype the CPU warm-tier and an async demote path (move cold keys off GPU on eviction instead of dropping). Should reduce misses.
Devon: one edge-case: demotion might increase network I/O and CPU mem. We'll add a soft throttle and monitor `demote_ops/sec`.
Marta: added dash widgets and alert thresholds: frag_ratio > 40% -> pager, oom_events > 0 in 15m -> pager.
Leo: good. Also add a small canary-only compaction mode that runs full defrag once to see benefits before enabling periodic.
Marta: ok actions assigned. I'll post progress updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
